title: Pharmacy Sales & Profitability Dashboard
summary: Power BI dashboard on a pharmacy sales and profitability dataset, covering revenue and profit trends, category performance, store size and geographic breakdowns.
problem: A pharmacy sales dataset needed to become a clear view of where revenue and profit come from.
objective: Show revenue and profit trends, category performance, and differences by store size and location.
approach: Built a two-page Power BI report: an Overview page and a Sales & Profitability page.
process: Explored the dataset and defined the questions the report should answer
Built the Overview page for headline trends
Built the Sales & Profitability page for category, store size and geographic breakdowns

title: Sales Performance Analysis (74,000+ rows)
summary: Cleaned and analysed 74,000+ rows of raw sales data, then built Power BI dashboards on revenue trends and performance drivers.
problem: Raw sales data with duplicates and inconsistent records could not be trusted for planning.
objective: Produce a clean dataset and dashboards that show revenue trends and what drives performance.
approach: Cleaned the data with SQL and Excel, modelled it, then built dashboards in Power BI.
process: Built Power BI dashboards for revenue trends and performance drivers
impact: Helped identify top-performing product lines and supported planning and resource prioritisation.

title: Layoffs Data Cleaning and Modelling Pipeline
summary: Full MySQL cleaning pipeline for a raw layoffs dataset, modelled into a star schema for visualisation.
problem: The raw layoffs dataset contained duplicates, inconsistent text and unparsed dates, so it could not be analysed reliably.
objective: Build a reproducible cleaning pipeline and a star schema ready for visualisation.
approach: Worked in a staging table so the raw data stayed untouched, then cleaned and modelled the data step by step.
process: Engineered features such as percentage laid off
Modelled the cleaned data into a star schema
impact: Shows end-to-end ETL design, data validation and reproducible documentation.

title: Clinical Performance Analytics Dashboard
summary: Tracks health operations KPIs such as no-show rates, patient wait times and provider utilisation.
problem: Health operations teams need to see no-show rates, wait times and provider utilisation in one place.
objective: Define the core clinical operations KPIs and track them in an interactive dashboard.
approach: Defined the KPIs, built the dashboard in Power BI, and applied data privacy best practice throughout.
process: Defined KPIs for no-show rates, patient wait times and provider utilisation
Applied data privacy best practice throughout
impact: Demonstrates readiness for health analytics roles.

title: Recruitment Workflow Automation
summary: End-to-end recruitment automation covering application intake, unique applicant IDs, CV extraction, HR notification, role-based scoring, shortlisting, interview scheduling and applicant communication.
problem: Manual application handling is slow, inconsistent and delays responses to candidates.
objective: Automate the journey from application to interview scheduling, with consistent scoring and timely candidate communication.
approach: Built the pipeline in n8n, triggered by a Google Form submission, with each stage handled by its own step.
process: Generated a unique ID for every applicant
Notified HR of each new application
Scored candidates against role-based criteria and shortlisted them
Debugged a JavaScript Code node for timestamp parsing and business-day calculation
Validated the full pipeline on a test cohort

results.text: Validated on a test cohort: ID generation, email delivery, CV extraction and scoring all worked correctly.
Designed to cut manual HR processing time by 60-80%.
Designed to reduce application-to-notification time from hours to minutes.

beforeAfter.before: Manual intake, reading and replying. Hours per applicant.
beforeAfter.after: Automated intake, scoring and reply. Minutes per applicant (projected).

impact: Faster, more consistent screening and quicker responses to candidates.

title: WhatsApp Customer Journey Workflow
summary: n8n workflow that automates a customer journey over WhatsApp using webhook and HTTP Request nodes, with production bugs identified and fixed.

title: Event Registration Automation
summary: Multi-path automation covering the full registration lifecycle with filtering, conditional routing, confirmation and reminder emails.
problem: Manual registration follow-up is slow and easy to get wrong.
objective: Handle registrations from submission to reminder without manual follow-up.
approach: Built a multi-path scenario in Make with filters and conditional routing.
process: Filtered and routed registrations by condition
impact: Removes manual follow-up from the registration process.

title: Automated Daily Sales Reporting Workflow
summary: Scheduled workflow that pulls data from Google Sheets, aggregates it and emails a daily report, replacing manual compilation and distribution.
problem: Compiling and sending a sales report by hand every day takes time and is easy to forget.
objective: Deliver the daily sales report automatically.
approach: A daily schedule trigger reads the sheet, aggregates the figures and sends the report by Gmail.
process: Pulled live data from Google Sheets
impact: Replaces manual report compilation and distribution.

title: Workflow Rebuild with Error Handling
summary: Rebuilt an existing automation independently, adding structured error triggers and automated alerts so failures are caught and reported immediately.
problem: An automation without error handling can fail silently.
objective: Rebuild the workflow so that every failure is caught and reported straight away.
approach: Rebuilt the automation independently, then added structured error triggers and automated alert notifications.
impact: Failures are caught and communicated immediately.

title: Bank Statement Processing and Transaction Cleaning Workflow
summary: n8n workflow that detects which bank a statement came from, identifies its header structure, and parses transactions into one clean, standard format.
problem: Bank statements arrive in different formats, so transactions cannot be combined or analysed without manual cleaning.
objective: Turn any supported bank statement into one clean, standard transaction format automatically.
approach: Custom Detect Bank & Header and universal Parse Statement Code nodes in n8n.
process: Detected the bank and header structure of each statement
Parsed transactions with a universal Parse Statement node
